knowledge:
- key_parameters: exprsMat=Input normalized data matrix (e.g., CPM, log2-CPM, logcounts) ;; cellType/cellTypes=Vector of cell-type labels, must match columns of exprsMat in length and order ;; exprsPct=Threshold between 0 and 1 for filtering lowly expressed genes (recommends 0.05 to 0.07 for microfluidic data) ;; logfc=Minimum log fold-change in gene expression to filter genes ;; computePvalue=Number of runs for p-value computation ;; computeFastPvalue=Logical, whether to use fast normal approximation (default TRUE, needs 100-200 runs) or permutation bootstrap (FALSE, recommends >= 10000 runs) ;; prefilter_pzero=Prefiltering parameter used during fast p-value computation ;; block=Vector indicating batch/block structure to run analysis independently per batch and average results ;; minCelltype=Minimum number of cells of a cell type in a block to keep it
- alternatives: Differential expression (DE) methods=Cepo is preferred over standard DE methods when the goal is to capture stable gene expression and subtle variations in distribution that do not necessarily involve changes in mean abundance ;; scMerge=Used for batch correction prior to Cepo, though Cepo's block argument can handle uncorrected batch data directly
- when_to_use: When identifying cell identity genes or marker genes from scRNA-seq data ;; For large-scale single-cell atlas datasets where computational efficiency is required ;; For multi-group comparisons in single-cell data
- pitfalls: If cell-type labels are unknown, cells must be clustered first ;; If batches are present and data is not batch-corrected, the block argument must be used to avoid batch-confounded results ;; Out-of-memory computation with DelayedArray is slower and should be paired with parallel processing via BiocParallel ;; The length and order of cellTypes must exactly match the columns of exprsMat

workflows.name: standard_differential_stability
workflows.intent: Run differential stability analysis on normalized scRNA-seq data to identify cell identity genes, with optional filtering, p-value calculation, and visualization.
input: cellbench (SingleCellExperiment object containing logcounts assay and celltype colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load data and extract logcounts matrix ;; 2. Run Cepo with default parameters ;; 3. Run Cepo with expression percentage filtering ;; 4. Run Cepo with log fold-change filtering ;; 5. Compute p-values using fast normal approximation or permutation bootstrap ;; 6. Extract top marker genes ;; 7. Visualize results using UpSet plots and density plots.
workflows.code:
library(Cepo)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
data("cellbench", package = "Cepo")
cellbench
cellbench = cellbench[!duplicated(rownames(cellbench)),]
ds_res = Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(cellbench),
              cellType = cellbench$celltype)
ds_res_zprop = Cepo::Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(cellbench),
                          cellTypes = cellbench$celltype,
                          exprsPct = 0.5)
ds_res_logfc = Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(cellbench),
                    cellTypes = cellbench$celltype,
                    logfc = 1)
ds_res_pvalues = Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(cellbench),
                      cellType = cellbench$celltype, 
                      computePvalue = 200,
                      prefilter_pzero = 0.4)
ds_res_pvalues = Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(cellbench),
                      cellType = cellbench$celltype, 
                      # we use a low value for demonstration purposes
                      computePvalue = 100,
                      computeFastPvalue = FALSE)
library(UpSetR)
res_name = topGenes(object = ds_res, n = 500)
upset(fromList(res_name), nsets = 3)
plotDensities(x = cellbench,
              cepoOutput = ds_res,
              nGenes = 2,
              assay = "logcounts",
              celltypeColumn = "celltype")
plotDensities(x = cellbench,
              cepoOutput = ds_res,
              genes = c("PLTP", "CPT1C", "MEG3", "SYCE1", "MICOS10P3", "HOXB7"),
              assay = "logcounts",
              celltypeColumn = "celltype")

workflows.name: batch_aware_differential_stability
workflows.intent: Perform differential stability analysis across multiple batches using the block argument to avoid batch effects.
input: sce_pancreas (SingleCellExperiment object containing counts assay, batch and cellTypes colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Load data and normalize ;; 2. Run Cepo with the block argument to perform analysis independently per batch ;; 3. Extract top genes from the averaged results.
workflows.code:
library(Cepo)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
data("sce_pancreas", package = "Cepo")
library(scater)
sce = sce_pancreas
sce = scater::logNormCounts(sce)
ds_res_batches = Cepo::Cepo(exprsMat = logcounts(sce),
                            cellTypes = sce$cellTypes,
                            block = sce$batch,
                            minCelltype = 2)
names(ds_res_batches)
cepo_genes = Cepo::topGenes(ds_res_batches$average, n = 3)

workflows.name: out_of_memory_parallel_differential_stability
workflows.intent: Run Cepo on large-scale atlas datasets using out-of-memory HDF5 arrays and parallel processing.
input: cellbench (SingleCellExperiment object containing logcounts assay and celltype colData)
workflows.stages: 1. Convert logcounts matrix to an HDF5-backed DelayedArray ;; 2. Run Cepo on the HDF5 matrix ;; 3. Configure parallel backend using BiocParallel and setAutoBPPARAM ;; 4. Run Cepo in parallel ;; 5. Revert parallel settings to serial.
workflows.code:
library(Cepo)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
data("cellbench", package = "Cepo")
cellbench = cellbench[!duplicated(rownames(cellbench)),]
library(DelayedArray)
library(HDF5Array)
da_matrix = DelayedArray(realize(logcounts(cellbench), "HDF5Array"))
da_output = Cepo(exprsMat = da_matrix, cellType = cellbench$celltype)
library(BiocParallel)
BPPARAM = if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
  BiocParallel::SnowParam(workers = 2)
} else {
  BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 2)
}
DelayedArray::setAutoBPPARAM(BPPARAM = BPPARAM) ## Setting two cores for computation
da_output_parallel = Cepo(exprsMat = da_matrix, cellTypes = cellbench$celltype)
DelayedArray::setAutoBPPARAM(BPPARAM = SerialParam()) ## Revert back to only one core
